title: Fogok Telefonálni: The Future Tense with fog

sections.title: A one-word "will"
sections.content: You know two ways to talk about the future from Unit 27: the present tense plus a future time word, like *Jövőre* *folyékonyan* *beszélek* *magyarul*, and *fog* plus an infinitive. Here you use *fog* for calls and appointments: *fogok* *telefonálni* means "I will call" — a more explicit statement of what will definitely happen, often a promise or a plan someone else is counting on.

items.english: Tomorrow I will call the doctor.

sections.content: *fog* itself never changes what the sentence means, person to person — it just marks the future, exactly like *kell* + infinitive or *lehet* + infinitive work. The real verb always stays a bare infinitive right after it.
